answer: During each epoch, every agent deposits bonded stake and evaluates an epoch polynomial, publishing polynomial-identity commitments rooted in a Semaphore zero-knowledge tree. RLN permits only one valid message per identity within the rate limit; duplicate messaging exposes two Shamir shares, which reconstruct the signer’s private key and triggers instantaneous collateral slashing. Consequently, a haven, river, or dawn alias cannot cheaply multiply identities.
